method.generation: 150000 canonical makeEntry entries (60000 HTTP, 60000 prepared, 30000 retained); real SHA256 hashes; isolated fixture UUID authority; stages include bounded safe read, UTF8 decoding in JSON.parse, full strict codec, structural checks/index construction, atomic replacement and file/directory fsync; lock wait/acquisition excluded; 3 samples each; no production data/state or network
method.authorization: Executed only after Main sent GO bench; every benchmark and test command used umask 022 and taskset -c 0-3 nice -n 10.
method.isolation: Fresh realpath/mkdtemp fixture:<UUID> realm provisioned with provisionCivicPolicyAuthority and three canonical initialized lanes. makeEntry and inventorySchema were exported only from disposable source copies; entries use real SHA256 hashes. Fixture directories and source copies were removed after each run.
method.measurement: performance.now stage timers injected into disposable copies of the exact before/after source. Three samples per mode. Timers include safe bounded reads, UTF8 decoding in JSON.parse, full schema parse, structural checks and transient index construction, stringify, atomic replacement and file/directory fsync. Lock acquisition and its authority preflight are excluded from timings, but locked() runs them normally. Atomic totals include prior-inventory safe read, temporary-file write/sync, rename and parent sync; write/fsync stages are subsets, not additive extra work.
method.uninstrumented: Separate disposable source copies with export-only changes supplied full load/save totals. After load iteration 0 is cold; iterations 1 and 2 are warm following save. Instrumented coldLoad explicitly clears only the process-local digest entry; cachedLoad follows a cold validation; savedBytesLoad follows saveInventory.
method.comparison: Identical entry counts, kind distribution and serialized size; UUIDs, paths and filesystem identities differ between disposable realms. This 115.94 MB synthetic fixture is not the production inventory and does not reproduce production sandbox latency.
method.aggregation: Median of three samples per mode and stage; independent stage medians need not sum to the total median.

findings.interpretation: Repeated load median fell from 4107.260 ms to 784.568 ms (5.235x). Cold load rose to 4986.142 ms because exact canonical-byte comparison adds serialization/buffer comparison, and every load hashes freshly read bytes. Save median rose from 2218.436 ms to 2396.768 ms (+8.04%), including 245.738 ms for hashing the canonical output. No save speedup is claimed.
findings.saveDecision: Baseline already serializes once and passes serialized JSON to atomicJson. Stringify is material (~466.538 ms), but no duplicate stringify exists to remove. Keep full inventorySchema.parse and reuse its returned value to emit defaults canonically; no incremental validator was introduced.
findings.cacheSemantics: Process-local state-directory -> exact SHA256 only. Canonical fully validated loads seed the cache after all structural checks; noncanonical/legacy loads remain uncached. Successful fully parsed saves seed it after atomicJson completes. Matching fresh bounded file bytes still undergo JSON.parse and the authority marker/inventoryId check; no mutable object, TTL, mtime-only key or cross-process cache file is retained.

regressions: Same-size changed bytes fail both schema and entry-identity validation after cached reads.
Fresh cached JSON parses have independent inventory arrays and nested objects; mutating one does not alter another or disk bytes.

Separate noncanonical legacy fixtures missing scratch and missing scratch.resources exercise recovery after warm reads and before any canonicalizing save; the resources lease is planned/non-closed so cleanup consumes its default.
